snippet.description:

Bluesky → https://bsky.app/profile/psychokin.bsky.social

ABOUT THE GAME
Psycho-Kin is an uber-stylized, top-down tactical shooter where you swap between two linked operatives to outwit enemies in tense, strategic combat - while uncovering a deep psychological story of espionage, trauma, and redemption.

STORY
Set in 1983, in an alternate history where the nuclear bomb was never invented, Psycho-Kin follows Richard, a retired member of an elite psychic unit created during a brutal arms race between the U.S. and Russia.

Haunted by nightmares, Richard attends therapy with Rachel, a sharp, quick-witted therapist who pushes him to confront his past. Through their sessions, he relives harrowing missions with his hot-headed partner Jack - uncovering buried secrets, the cost of their abilities, and the shadows of a life he can’t escape.

GAMEPLAY
Psycho-Kin is a top-down shooter where you control two characters, switching between them by eliminating enemies strategically placed throughout the map. Each foe is linked to vital elements like doors, blocking access to key areas. Plan your kills wisely to navigate the intricate web of connections and unlock every corner of the stage. Utilize the map overview mode to visualize the links between enemies and doors, allowing you to plan your moves carefully.
